introHtml: Multi color golf polo shirts let you combine two or more brand colors into one sharp uniform, making your logo stand out on the course or at company outings. Unlike single-color polos, these shirts use contrasting collars, plackets, or sleeve bands to create a sporty, layered look that reads as intentional and polished. Whether you are outfitting a sales team for a charity tournament or ordering staff uniforms for a golf-themed event, multi color polos offer more visual interest without sacrificing the classic polo silhouette. Choose from moisture-wicking performance fabrics and customize with embroidery or screen printing.
heroAltText: Custom multi color golf polo shirts with contrasting collar and sleeve bands, embroidered logo on chest
